notes.title: Rumbly - Update 0.1.9 is live!
notes.content:
[p]Update 0.1.9[/p][p]We’ve made [b]major HP adjustments to many enemies[/b] across the game!
Now you can blast through battles faster and enjoy a smoother, more thrilling run.[/p][p]Try the new balance and let us know what you think!
Demo available now on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612210/Rumbly/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
